search_boundary: Two targeted official-source search groups and two official news indexes covering named sodium-ion delivery, grid commissioning, customer acceptance and public field performance; not an exhaustive market census.

sources_checked.finding: CATL's official English index contains no post-31 October case-scope item. The 27 October INTILION memorandum remains the newest listed sodium-ion item and does not establish a named commissioned sodium-ion site.
INTILION's official press index exposes no sodium-ion delivery, commissioning, acceptance or field-performance record. Its listed commissioned systems are not identified as sodium-ion.

provenance_note: The 27 October CATL-INTILION memorandum remains a pending append-only record outside authoritative main. This review does not duplicate, overwrite or treat it as newly discovered today.
